bestBets.overview: BUONGIORNO showed plenty of encouraging signs on debut, finishing behind a couple of impressive ones. Grunge gets the nod on his overall profile and looks capable of getting every chance from the favourable draw. Buongiorno and Ocean Predator get promoted into numbers.
